segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Hi Maria, this is Sam Rivera from Northbeam sales. As agreed, we are talking about the annual plan for your team.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hello Sam. We like the product, but the price for sixty seats is above our budget.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I understand. I can do twenty-five percent off the list price if you sign this week.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Twenty-five would help a lot. Can you put that in writing?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Yes, I'll send the revised quote by Tuesday with the discount included.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Great. Our finance team will review it as soon as it arrives.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Perfect. I will also share the implementation timeline so finance sees the full picture.
